newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated muni sales to total $577 mln on Sept 10.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated muni sales to total $577 mln on Sept 10.

text.p: Scheduled negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $577 million in nine offerings on Tuesday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
The largest issue is expected to be a $325 million Washington Public Power Supply System refunding deal through Goldman Sachs & Co.
Another $203 million of deals are on the possible list for Tuesday, meaning underwriters may decide to price the issues depending on market conditions.
